scope: Post-hoc DEV-only diagnostic of unlabeled image/question features for choosing among existing E4 outputs; no new generation or labels

features.gray_entropy16: Convert original image to 8-bit grayscale; resize to 256x256 with PIL bilinear; histogram into 16 equal bins; Shannon entropy base 2 in bits.
features.gray_gradient: Same grayscale image; mean absolute horizontal difference plus mean absolute vertical difference, computed as signed integer differences divided by 255.
features.user_text_chars: Number of Unicode code points across all text parts of the original user message, including instructions and options.

rules: For each task and each of three features separately, allocate K512 to the 42 highest values among its 128 images, with SHA256('20261105|'+group_id) ascending as tie breaker, and K128 to the other 86. Predeclare all three and do not select a winner as confirmed.
random: Three same-budget allocations: rank SHA256('20261105|random|seed|'+group_id) ascending for seed 0,1,2; first 42 K512, remainder K128. Report all seeds.
cost: All rules total 42*512 + 86*128 = 32512, mean K254; fixed comparator K256 totals 32768. K counts are not actual measured compute, memory or latency.
analysis: First extract features and write a frozen feature file without reading score journal or labels; then join existing E4 D1 per-question scores and report all 3 feature rules, all 3 random seeds and fixed K256 for each task. Each task has 128 image groups; no new predictions, GT, CONFIRM or FINAL accessed. No selection-based significance claim.
limitations: Post-hoc exploratory feature panel designed after seeing DEV aggregate and answer oracle
Batch rank uses all 128 test images and per-task knowledge; it is not an online deployable policy
No actual runtime or equal-compute claim; no selector cost included
Three features are cheap heuristics, no novelty claim
All rules must be reported regardless of direction
